entities.name: Crescênzio Rinaldini
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Crescênzio Rinaldini was a Roman Catholic prelate who served as bishop of the Diocese of Araçuaí, Brazil between 1982 and 2001. Ordained priest in Brescia in 1949, he became a bishop emeritus upon his retirement in 2001.
